name: Schedule Operation
description: Schedule a grid operation to run at a future time, once or on a fixed interval. Returns a handle used to trigger the event early or cancel it. The operation fires with the authority captured from the caller. A tracked fire is a durable Job in your job history; an untracked fire leaves no record beyond the log.

operation.description: Reference of the operation to invoke when due

input.description: Input passed to the operation when it fires

time.description: Absolute first fire time, in milliseconds since the epoch

after.description: Fire after this many milliseconds from now (alternative to time)

repeat.description: Recurrence. Omit for a one-shot event. With repeat, time/after set the first fire (default: one interval from now); the event then re-fires on the every-millis grid, skipping any slots missed while the venue was down.

track.description: Whether each fire runs as a durable Job (visible in your job history, its ID reported as lastJob on a recurring event). Omit to use the venue default; an operator may force tracking on.

time.description: Absolute first fire time, in milliseconds since the epoch

repeat.description: The canonical recurrence spec, when recurring
